headline: Mild, foggy mornings and sunny afternoons through Thursday, then cooler, breezier, mostly dry weather Friday.
summary: A steady high-pressure setup keeps winds light and the pattern largely unchanged through Thursday. Low clouds and fog form overnight over Puget Sound and usually burn off around noon, followed by sunny afternoons. Highs stay mostly in the 60s to low 70s, with Thursday the warmest day. On Tuesday and Wednesday, slightly stronger winds may bring more morning clouds and less fog, and dense fog is possible tonight. From Friday into the weekend, a dip in the jet stream brings more clouds, wind, and cooler weather, with highs in the upper 50s to low 60s. Showers are possible, mostly Friday into Saturday, but widespread rain does not look likely, and the timing of the dip is still uncertain.
